companyHella.label: Forvia Hella
companyHella.description: Forvia Hella is a global technology leader in automotive electronics and lighting. Its development and manufacturing centers in the Czech Republic are a hub for international innovation, process digitization, and data-driven manufacturing. Combining product development with large-scale manufacturing infrastructure places stringent demands on internal software stability, enterprise architecture, and process data reliability.
values: Developed progressive web applications across the full stack to digitize processes, streamline workflows, and collect manufacturing data.
Designed, implemented, and supported a manufacturing execution system in an environment with critical availability requirements and strict automotive industry standards.
Integrated modern web interfaces with existing production hardware and industrial production lines.
Collaborated on international projects in global teams, using English as the working language.

projectUnitExplorer.label: Unit Explorer
projectUnitExplorer.displayDescription: A progressive web application for detailed diagnostics and lifecycle tracking of headlamp assemblies throughout manufacturing.
values: Enabled end-to-end part traceability with real-time visibility into test results, telemetry readings, and bills of materials.
Streamlined internal quality audits and accelerated tracing of defective batches and components.
Built a responsive interface optimized for mobile devices and industrial terminals on assembly lines, with full desktop support.
Consolidated and validated data from multiple test stations in a single, easy-to-read view.
Prioritized application stability and resilience to outages to support round-the-clock assembly line operations.

projectProjectServer.label: Project Server
projectProjectServer.displayDescription: A centralized web platform that replaced the legacy project server and supports the management, remote launch, and runtime monitoring of JNLP applications on workstations across the company.
values: Redesigned the legacy architecture from the ground up as a stable, scalable web platform.
Centralized remote oversight and real-time status monitoring for hundreds of production terminals.
Ensured the secure and reliable operation of critical production line software.

atreoDigital.label: Atreo Digital
atreoDigital.description: An Ostrava-based technology company focused on custom digital product development, applied AI, and process automation. It builds complex web applications and internal systems and integrates business tools, with an emphasis on modern architecture, data security, and long-term scalability.
values: Develop web applications and internal systems across the full stack, using an AI-first workflow to accelerate delivery while maintaining rigorous engineering oversight.
Analyze clients' business requirements, design data models, and implement custom algorithms and computational logic.
Continuously refactor existing client systems and systematically address bottlenecks.
Maintain code quality and stability through regular code reviews, testing, and reliable production deployments.

projectMonery.label: Monery
projectMonery.displayDescription: A fintech platform for managing, visualizing, and analyzing investment portfolios across multiple brokers.
values: Analyzed calculation models and implemented algorithms to accurately measure portfolio performance and dividend income and generate supporting tax data.
Integrated external market data sources with the internal data model to automatically retrieve asset prices, historical exchange rates, and fundamental metrics.
Built robust parsers to process and normalize transaction exports from multiple brokers and platforms.
Designed and implemented analytics dashboards that make complex financial metrics and portfolio composition easy to understand.

projectIdeaStatica.label: IDEA StatiCa
projectIdeaStatica.displayDescription: A complete replatforming and modernization of the web platform for a global leader in structural engineering and analysis software.
values: Led a small technical team of two frontend developers, one backend developer, and a QA tester. Translated business requirements into technical tasks and coordinated implementation.
Engineered core frontend features, designed a modular component architecture, and optimized load performance.
Maintained code quality and consistency through regular code reviews, managed version control in Git, and handled production deployments.

projectXTuning.label: XTuning
projectXTuning.displayDescription: A vehicle diagnostics and tuning platform for customers and administrators.
values: Analyzed requirements and designed workflows for managing customers, orders, and available vehicle upgrades.
Designed features for vehicle diagnostics, diagnostic trouble code display, and engine control unit tuning.
Built a multilingual frontend with reusable components and separate customer and administrative portals.
Developed the backend and data model for managing orders and products.

selfEmployment.label: Jakub Švihel Tech
selfEmployment.description: End-to-end development of custom web applications and digital products for businesses and individuals, covering everything from initial business analysis and visual design to implementation and infrastructure management.
values: Manage projects end to end, from initial negotiations and requirements definition through handover and launch.
Develop visual identities and design intuitive, responsive user interfaces.
Design system architectures, select technology stacks suited to each project, and implement solutions across the full stack.
Set up infrastructure, manage production deployments including hosting, domains, and CI/CD, and provide ongoing technical support and system maintenance.

projectMoonea.label: Moonea
projectMoonea.displayDescription: A modern e-commerce platform for sustainable living, featuring eco-friendly children's toys and organic products.
values: Designed and built a minimalist storefront with a clean visual identity and clear product presentation.
Developed a flexible backend to manage the full product catalog, orders, and customer data.
Implemented the complete checkout flow, including payment and shipping integrations.

projectRealEstate.label: Real Estate Agent Websites
projectRealEstate.displayDescription: A collection of single-page websites for CENTURY 21 real estate agents, built on a shared modular architecture.
values: Designed and built reusable components so each agent's site could be adapted efficiently in both content and appearance.
Followed CENTURY 21's global brand and design guidelines while maintaining a clean, straightforward visual style.

oKrokNapred.label: O krok napřed
oKrokNapred.displayDescription: A nonprofit website that educates the public about cancer prevention and provides reliable information on cancer.
values: Designed a clean, accessible interface that makes content easy to read and navigate.
Utilized Static Site Generation to deliver fast page loads and improve search engine visibility.
Leveraged Firebase for data storage, allowing the nonprofit to run the site without ongoing maintenance or operating costs.

universityPalacky.label: Palacký University Olomouc
universityPalacky.description: University studies in modern software design and development methods, advanced programming, and large-scale software projects. The program emphasized software architecture, collaborative development, algorithmic thinking, and applying these skills to complex engineering problems.
values: Master's program specializing in software development and large-scale software systems.
Focused on software architecture, algorithmic thinking, teamwork, and solving complex engineering problems in practical settings.

diplomaThesis.label: Master's Thesis – KlikFit
diplomaThesis.displayDescription: A full-stack web platform that enables coaches and clients to create personalized training plans automatically or manually, track athletic progress, and communicate.
values: Developed a multistage algorithm that automatically generates training plans based on priority scores, exercise sequencing rules, and specified performance limits.
Designed a scalable architecture based on the MVC pattern, with a separate client interface and a backend REST API connected to a relational database.
Implemented progress tracking with dynamic charts and two-way real-time chat, featuring QR code-based user pairing.

bachelorThesis.label: Bachelor's Thesis – Paziaatus
bachelorThesis.displayDescription: A desktop game that combines Pazaak, the turn-based card game from Star Wars, with role-playing mechanics inspired by Gladiatus and Shakes & Fidget.
values: Implemented a decision-making algorithm for a computer-controlled opponent that analyzes the state of play, evaluates probabilities, and chooses when to use special cards.
Designed an object-oriented MVC architecture, integrated a database for item attributes, implemented save-game persistence, and used a dedicated thread to decrease character needs in real time.
Designed the user interface with a custom scaling system and created 200 game assets using the DALL·E generative model.

gymnasiumNovyJicin.label: Gymnázium Nový Jičín
gymnasiumNovyJicin.description: A four-year upper secondary program that provided a foundation in algorithm design, mathematical reasoning, and analytical problem-solving.
values: Completed a general secondary education with a focus on science and information technology.
Built theoretical and practical foundations in algorithm design, mathematical methods, and logical problem-solving.

maturitaThesis.label: Secondary School Graduation Project – Wake-Up Light
maturitaThesis.displayDescription: Designed and built a wake-up light that gradually increases light intensity to suppress melatonin production and support natural waking.
values: Developed modular embedded firmware for the LCD interface and accurate timekeeping via a real-time clock module.
Designed the circuit, used a transistor to control the brightness of a high-power LED, and assembled and soldered the electronics by hand.
Designed a custom two-piece enclosure and 3D-printed it in PLA.
